mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES stops falling and TRANSIT improves, commuters regain weekday routines and make incidental shopping trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded from -23.7 to -9.9 while TRANSIT improved from -28.1 to -23.3 in the latest week
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain weak or worsen and RETAIL_REC still rises over the next 28 days, the commuting-to-retail mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility above the recent range means more time spent at home, which reduces discretionary outings and pushes RETAIL_REC lower within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above +15 for at least one week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed elevated at 11.4, 15.1, 17.1, and 13.9 while RETAIL_REC stayed negative
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL moves above +15 and RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 7 to 14 days, the home-stay suppression mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: An upswing in GROCERY_PHARM indicates essential-trip substitution toward nearby stores and away from discretionary mall visits, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks when grocery mobility is high and retail remains negative.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rebounds by at least 8 points from the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 13.7 at t-2w and RETAIL_REC fell to -12.0
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rebounds by 8 points or more but RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the following 14 days, the substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility drops abruptly after a brief improvement, it signals a tightening of social-outing tolerance or adverse weather, and retail visits follow lower within four weeks as nonessential leisure trips are curtailed.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from 0.7 at t-2w to -19.4 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC stayed negative
failure_condition: If PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not decline further over the next 28 days, the outing-suppression mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A joint recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates more commuting trips and more exposure to retail corridors, which raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks only when both series improve together.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -23.7 to -9.9 while TRANSIT improved from -28.1 to -23.3 in the latest week
failure_condition: If only one of WORKPLACES or TRANSIT improves and RETAIL_REC still increases, the interaction requirement is false.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS remains depressed after a prior dip, outdoor leisure demand is not absorbing weekend time, so postponed shopping trips partially return and RETAIL_REC improves over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays below -10 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -19.4 at t-0w after being 0.7 at t-2w
failure_condition: If PARKS stays below -10 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days, the deferred-leisure rebound mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES marks a mobility clampdown that suppresses discretionary shopping trips with a short lag, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both decline week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remained below -20 and WORKPLACES was -22.0 at t-2w before partial recovery
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both decline week-on-week but RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 7 days, the clampdown mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM together with elevated RESIDENTIAL reflects stock-up behavior and home-centered routines, which diverts spending from malls and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 10 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 12
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 11.6 and RESIDENTIAL was 11.4 at t-3w, then RESIDENTIAL stayed elevated above 13
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises above 10 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 12 and RETAIL_REC does not decline over 28 days, the stock-up diversion mechanism is rejected.
